artworks.title: Christophe Gabriel Allegrain
artworks.artist: Ignaz Sebastian Klauber after Joseph Siffred Duplessis
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated man facing slightly to the left. He has curly, shoulder-length hair and a distinguished nose. The man wears formal attire with a buttoned coat and holds a sculpting tool in his right hand. Beside him, the bare legs of a statue on a pedestal are visible. The background is dark, with an ornate border featuring captions identifying him as Christophe Gabriel Allegrain, a sculptor and academician.

artworks.title: Anne Vallayer-Coster
artworks.artist: Charles Francois Le Tellier after Anne Vallayer-Coster
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait in profile of a person facing right. The individual is positioned sideways, with the head turned slightly towards the viewer's side. The person has tall, voluminous coiffures adorned with what appears to be ribbons or decorative elements within the hair. The face shows classical features with a calm and serene expression. The attire is elaborate, with decorative lace or elaborate fabric around the neckline and shoulders. Surrounding the portrait is an ornate circular frame decorated with leafy motifs, possibly laurel leaves. Below the portrait, there is a decorative panel with scripted text, an artist’s palette, and brushes. The background of the image is filled with fine, detailed crosshatching.

artworks.title: Hubert Gravelot
artworks.artist: Jean Massard after Maurice-Quentin de La Tour
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man's upper body in profile, focusing on his face and shoulders. The man has curly short hair and detailed facial features, including prominent eyes, a slightly hooked nose, and a firm mouth. He wears a coat with a high collar and a shirt with ruffles. The portrait is enclosed by a circular ornate border with a decorative ribbon or bow at the top. The background has a textured, cross-hatched pattern, and the name "Hubert Gravelot" is inscribed below the portrait.

artworks.title: Jean Restout
artworks.artist: Pierre Etienne Moitte after Maurice-Quentin de La Tour
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man seated with a drawing tool in his right hand, resting on a large sheet of paper on his lap. The man has distinguished facial features and is looking slightly to his right. He has curls in his hair and is wearing an elaborate 18th-century outfit with a long coat and a cravat. He sits in an upholstered chair with a scroll design on top, and behind him is an easel with a blank canvas. The background is simple.

artworks.title: Nicolas Poussin
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a bust-length portrait. He is facing slightly left with a gaze towards the viewer. The man has well-defined facial features, a prominent nose, and lips set in a neutral expression. He has long, wavy hair, and is wearing a draped garment with intricate shading. He holds a scroll tied with a ribbon in his right hand. In the background, there are stacked picture frames, with an image of a classical figure wearing a crown visible in one frame. The background is intricately engraved with detailed line work.

artworks.title: Jean Baptiste Simeon Chardin
artworks.description: The image shows a profile portrait of a man's head and shoulders framed within an oval medallion. The man is positioned in profile, facing to the right, with defined facial features, including a prominent nose and brow. The man's hair is styled in curls cascading down from his face, typical of 18th-century wigs. He wears a jacket with a leaf or flower pattern. The medallion is topped with a decorative ribbon or bow. The portrait is set against a textured background within the oval frame, which rests on a rectangular base with text detailing the name and titles of the artist Jean-Siméon Chardin. The creator information at the bottom of the image indicates it was drawn in 1776.

artworks.title: Jean Baptiste Descamps
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with a side profile of his head and upper shoulders, within a rounded frame. The man has a prominent nose, a slightly pointed chin, and tied back hair. He wears formal period clothing, and the background is textured. The circular frame has a decorative bow on top, and the bottom displays engraved text with the name "Jean-Baptiste Descamps" and additional information about him.

artworks.title: Jean Jouvenet
artworks.description: The image shows an upper half portrait of a man seated in an ornately carved chair. He is turned slightly to his right, holding a painter's palette and brushes in his left hand while his right hand is raised with one finger pointing upward. He wears attire from the late 17th to early 18th century, including a voluminous robe with wide sleeves and lace cuffs at the wrists. His facial features include a high forehead and pronounced nose, with a composed expression. His hair is curly and styled in the fashion of the time, falling past his shoulders. In the background, there is a draped curtain in a dimly lit interior. The portrait is set within an oval frame, with a pedestal below bearing the inscription "JEAN JOUVENET Peintre Ordinaire du Roy Directeur de l’Academie Royale 1707."

artworks.title: San Gimignano
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Sam R. Broadbent
artworks.description: The image depicts a cityscape with ancient stone towers and buildings rising against the sky. The horizon is near the top of the image. The towers are intricately detailed, showcasing historical architecture. Vegetation with swirling lines is shown in the foreground. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray and black to convey timelessness and solemnity, with stark contrasts between light and shadow.

artworks.title: The Hat Pin (Le chapeau epingle)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Sam R. Broadbent
artworks.description: The image displays a partial view of two women's upper bodies, mainly focusing on their heads and shoulders. One woman is seated with her head slightly turned to the side, and the other woman is standing or leaning toward her, their heads close together. The woman on the left has long hair, while the woman on the right has her face partially obscured. Both women are wearing large brimmed hats with floral decorations. The seated woman appears to be adjusting the brim of her hat with one hand. The artwork is an etching with delicate swirling line work defining the figures and their surroundings. The background features expressive swirling lines, adding movement and depth to the composition, with no distinct objects visible beyond the figures.

artworks.title: The Four Horsemen
artworks.creditLine: Ferdinand Lammot Belin Fund and William Nelson Cromwell Fund

artworks.title: A Boy with a Lute
artworks.medium: black chalk and charcoal, heightened with white chalk on (faded) blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Ruth and Vernon Taylor Foundation
artworks.description: The drawing depicts the upper body of a person facing the viewer. The person has soft eyes, a straight nose, and slightly parted lips, suggesting a relaxed expression. The individual's hair is wavy and appears to be tied back. They are dressed in a garment with light and dark stripes and a high collar or ruff. The figure holds a long object in their hand. The background is plain and textured, emphasizing the subject.

artworks.title: Study for a Painting
artworks.description: The image contains swirling lines and elongated shapes forming an abstract composition resembling a surreal landscape. The central shape is tall and rectangular. Surrounding it are curved, flowing lines and rounded forms, creating an abstract scene blending architecture with nature.

artworks.title: Lewisohn Stadium, New York
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with charcoal and gray wash on brown paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with seated figures and architectural elements. The image features a large gathering of people in a busy setting. The figures are drawn with loose, sketchy lines that suggest motion. The background includes large structures. The style of the drawing focuses on capturing the essence of a busy environment. The use of shadows and lines creates depth.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: red, black, and white chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's head and shoulders, emphasizing the face with details such as a furrowed brow, prominent cheekbones, and a grin. The person has curly, unkempt hair. The clothing is loosely suggested. The drawing is monochromatic, with the name "JEROME MYERS" and the year "1928" inscribed in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Allegory of "Pride Goeth Before Destruction...": A Gentleman and a Lady on Horseback
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.2 x 27.8 cm (7 15/16 x 10 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The etching depicts a scene with a knight falling off a rearing horse, a man interacting with a large creature, and a distant landscape with a village, church, houses, mountain, and a castle atop it. The sky is clear, emphasizing the hills and structures. The artwork features detailed line work typical of renaissance prints, giving depth and texture to each element with intricate contours and shading. The monochromatic color palette contributes to the scene's ambiance. In the top portion, there is a framed inscription with a decorative border.

artworks.title: Emperors Charles V and Ferdinand I
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.9 x 27.6 cm (7 13/16 x 10 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two men depicted from the waist up, seated and facing one another. The man on the left has a bearded face with prominent features, and his hair is styled in a short, structured manner. He wears an intricate, decorative robe adorned with patterns, along with a chain or necklace featuring large medallions or ornaments. Atop his head is a cap with a small brim. The man on the right has clean-shaven facial features and a distinctive jawline, with hair styled in a chin-length bob. He is wearing an ornate hat embellished with round motifs and a robe trimmed with fur. Both men have their hands resting on a table or platform covered with a floral-patterned cloth. In the background, an arch with ornamental carvings frames the scene, featuring cherubic figures and motifs, and a medallion or coat of arms hangs from the center.

artworks.title: Interior of  the Church of Saint Maria Magdalena with the Parable of the Offering of the Widow
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29 x 20.1 cm (11 7/16 x 7 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior with vaulted ceilings and columns. The image depicts an interior view of a grand building with vaulted ceilings supported by detailed columns. Arched windows let in light, and decorative elements adorn the arches and ceilings. The perspective emphasizes the height and depth of the space. In the foreground, there is a solitary column on a raised platform. Figures are included in the space. Lines and shading techniques create a sense of three-dimensionality and depth.

artworks.title: Jesus Christ Giving the Mission to the Apostles and Other New Testament Scenes
artworks.description: This is an engraving of various biblical scenes. The engraving features detailed biblical scenes divided into sections, each illustrating different narratives, accompanied by text blocks in Gothic script. The upper section depicts figures under arches and in a courtyard, with a strong architectural presence in the background. Outdoor scenes show soldiers and peasants performing actions. In the lower section, groups of figures gather under trees and in front of a domed building, with one noticeably emaciated figure, and scenes of teaching or preaching. Buildings and hilly landscapes adorn the skyline, adding depth to the scenes. The composition is detailed, showcasing the use of line and shading to create texture and dimension, typical of master engravings from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Ornament for Dagger Sheath
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three decorative vertical panels with intricate floral designs. The panels showcase variations of an ornate pattern with foliage and stylized flowers arranged symmetrically. Each panel is framed within a rectangular border. The middle panel has a circular form at the bottom and prominent floral clusters. The right panel includes a subtle depiction of a face or mask within the design. The background is dark with the designs in a lighter tone, creating a contrast. The composition suggests elegance and detailed craftsmanship.

artworks.title: Two Candelabrum Designs
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring two highly detailed and intricate ornamental designs. The left design includes a tall, column-like structure with various embellishments such as human figures, animals, and decorative elements. A bowl-like structure adorned with flames is at the top, supported by chained elements. The middle section showcases curves and ornate carvings, while the base features a detailed scene of a combat between horse riders. The right design is also a towering structure with decorative motifs including winged creatures and elaborate patterns. The top is crowned by a winged beast holding scepters. Both designs are set against a plain background, emphasizing their detailed craftsmanship and artistic intricacy.

artworks.title: Reliquary with Pietà
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.6 x 15.6 cm (8 7/8 x 6 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The artwork consists of detailed lines and intricate shapes arranged in an abstract composition. The shapes resemble floral patterns and human figures, with a central scene showing a group of people. Above the central figures, there are smaller angelic forms and decorative scrolls, forming a symmetrical structure topped with a figure holding a staff. The composition is framed with swirling leaves and abstract embellishments, reminiscent of a tapestry or decorative frieze showcasing a blend of reality and myth.

artworks.title: Soldier Embracing a Woman
artworks.description: The image portrays two individuals standing closely together, a man and a woman. The man is positioned behind and to the side of the woman, leaning forward towards her. He has short hair and a mustache, with closely set eyes. The woman's face is turned slightly towards the man, with long, wavy hair and a headpiece. She wears a dress with patterned sleeves and a fitted bodice. They are surrounded by a leafy tree bearing fruit, with a fenced area, a mountain, a seated figure under a tree, and birds in the background. The image features intricate patterns and textures throughout.

artworks.title: Three German Soldiers Armed with Halberds
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.7 x 13.2 cm (3 7/16 x 5 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows three men in ancient armor standing in different poses. The first man on the left has one hand on his hip and the other holding a tall pole weapon. The middle man gestures outward and holds a similar weapon upright. The third man stands facing left, with a feathered hat. All three wear puffed sleeve armor with ornate detailing. Two men have sheathed swords, and there is a dog at the feet of the first man. The background is lightly sketched with trees on the far left side.
